title: Compile every rank-one actual class with finite-interval and disabled-coordinate branches
statement: For rational complex-balanced input remove zero jumps. Rank0 gives singleton classes. Rank1 yields integral primitive v and integers h_r with z_r-y_r=h_r v. If v has both signs, x0+k v>=0 restricts k to an EXPLICIT finite integer interval; enumerate enabled edges and the actual component, then use rational finite-tree resistances (singleton ell=1 vacuous). Otherwise orient v>=0, set kmin=max_{v_i>0}ceil(-x0_i/v_i),a=x0+kmin v,k0=-kmin, so all possible populations are x(k)=a+k v,k>=0. A reaction with an underfilled fixed coordinate v_i=0 is disabled on the entire line, as is its adjoint, and is removed. If no nonzero enabled-line jump remains the class is singleton. This preserves exact disabled boundaries and actual components rather than replacing them by a saturated stoichiometric lattice.
